args.summary: Played about 190 steps as a new player. Most of the session was ending turns and answering event cards, which felt repetitive. The advisor auto-pick for production helped. Autosave works. Diplomacy list opened on the wrong people at first. Ruler points and governor prompts stayed unspent because I did not know what they did.

thought: Reached the end of the session budget; the game feels repetitive but is stable.
